sample: A sample judgment for the worked example, filled in by hand to show what a verdict looks like and what judge record does with it. It is one reading of the packet, not a model run, and another judge may answer differently. hyperspec ignores this field.

conditions.evidence: Your first one-on-one with a new report is the only meeting on your calendar where they should set the agenda.
conditions.note: the first sentence says the report sets the agenda

conditions.evidence: What should I stop doing, or start doing, that would make your week easier?
conditions.note: all three numbered questions read word for word as the voice memo has them

conditions.evidence: 11 of 41 said at least one of their one-on-ones in the last quarter was mostly project status.

conditions.evidence: Three is enough to hand the meeting over.
conditions.note: the sections carry c1, c2, c3 and c4 in that order; the paragraphs on writing the answers down and keeping urgent items out serve c1, that the meeting stays the report's

conditions.evidence: Wait after each question, longer than you want to.
